title: 实验技术与安全
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training Series/10_Lab Techniques & Safety Crash Course Chemistry 21.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training Series/10_Lab Techniques & Safety Crash Course Chemistry 21/src.py

points.K1: 最糟的一天：样品被洗掉
points.K7: 护目用品，普通眼镜不算
points.K12: 用前先读安全技术说明书
points.K22: 玻璃管插塞子：润滑、近握
points.K25: 用之前，先知道怎么处置
points.K27: 衣物大量沾染，立即脱掉

shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室中央，身后是通风柜和水槽
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in the middle of a lab with a fume hood and a sink behind it, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，学在实验室里好好保护自己。

shots.scene: 护目镜、扎起的头发、通风柜、废液桶、喷淋头五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: safety goggles, tied-up hair, a fume hood, a waste container and an emergency shower head. No people.
shots.narration: 穿什么、怎么做、出了事怎么办。

shots.scene: 小研给新来的阿杰讲自己刚进实验室时的故事
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student chats with the young male student by the lab door, telling him a story with lively gestures.
shots.narration: 小研给新来的阿杰讲了一个故事。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 故事里，藏着好几条安全规矩。

shots.section_title: 最糟的一天：样品被洗掉
shots.scene: 阿杰熬夜一周，桌上摆着一排贴空白标签的样品瓶
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, tired after many late nights, looks proudly at a row of small sample vials with blank labels on his bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰熬了一周，备好一排样品。
overlay: 最糟的一天：样品被洗掉

shots.section_title: 最糟的一天：样品被洗掉
shots.scene: 阿杰趴在休息室桌上睡着
shots.prompt_en: The young male student falls asleep with his head on a table in a break room.
shots.narration: 他终于去补了个觉。

shots.section_title: 最糟的一天：样品被洗掉
shots.scene: 另一名同学背影，在水槽边把样品瓶冲洗干净
shots.prompt_en: At the lab sink, an unknown person seen only from behind rinses out a row of small vials.
shots.narration: 有人找不到瓶子，把它们全洗了。

shots.scene: 阿杰回来看到空瓶，气得握紧拳头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student returns, sees the empty clean vials and clenches his fist in frustration.
shots.narration: 阿杰气坏了。

shots.scene: 拳头捶向纸巾盒、手被划伤的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fist hitting a paper towel dispenser with a small cut on the hand, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 一拳捶向纸巾盒，手被划破了。

shots.scene: 欣欣无奈地摇头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot shakes its head with a sympathetic look.
shots.narration: 很多实验室受伤，都来自这种一时冲动。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起两张空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up two blank cards.
shots.narration: 先记住两条教训。

shots.scene: 别人的样品瓶上有问号，伸过去的手被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand reaching for someone else's unfamiliar vial with a question mark, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不认识的瓶子，不要去洗。

shots.scene: 拳头和实验设备之间的打叉图标，旁边是深呼吸的小人
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a fist near lab equipment crossed out with a red X, next to a calm person pictogram taking a deep breath. No people.
shots.narration: 再生气，也别拿东西撒气。

shots.scene: 小研把长发扎成低发髻
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties her long hair back into a low bun before entering the lab.
shots.narration: 先说穿戴：长头发一定要扎起来。

shots.scene: 披散的长发靠近酒精灯火焰的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of loose long hair hanging near a small flame, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 散着头发，靠近火焰会着火。

shots.scene: 长发扫倒烧杯、挡住视线、垂进烧瓶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: loose hair knocking over a beaker, hair covering the eyes, and hair dipping into a flask. No people.
shots.narration: 还会碰翻东西、挡视线、垂进烧瓶。

shots.scene: 宽大垂袖扫过烧杯的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wide hanging sleeve sweeping across beakers on a bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 宽松下垂的衣物，尤其是大袖子，不行。

shots.scene: 小研穿长袖、长裤、包脚鞋，外套实验服
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stands in long sleeves, long trousers, closed-toe shoes and socks, with a buttoned lab coat.
shots.narration: 长袖、长裤、包脚鞋，再穿上袜子。

shots.scene: 凉鞋、背心、露腰短上衣三个图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out with red X marks: sandals, a sleeveless vest and a cropped top. No people.
shots.narration: 凉鞋、背心、露腰装，都不能进实验室。

shots.section_title: 护目用品，普通眼镜不算
shots.scene: 欣欣指着自己眼睛
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to its own eyes with a serious face.
shots.narration: 眼睛最脆弱，必须戴护目用品。
overlay: 护目用品，普通眼镜不算

shots.section_title: 护目用品，普通眼镜不算
shots.scene: 阿杰把护目镜罩在普通眼镜外面
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts safety goggles on over his everyday glasses.
shots.narration: 普通眼镜不算，要罩上护目镜。

shots.scene: 阿杰揉眼睛，一脸难受
shots.prompt_en: The young male student squints and rubs one eye uncomfortably at his bench.
shots.narration: 眼睛刺痛、不舒服，

shots.scene: 小研扶他到洗眼器前，撑开眼睑冲洗
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student guides him to an eyewash station; he holds his eyelids open in the water streams under an eyewash sign.
shots.narration: 就算不知道进了什么，也马上冲洗。

shots.scene: 流水冲眼和受伤眼睛两个图标，前者打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: an eye being rinsed with a green check, and a red injured eye. No people.
shots.narration: 冲洗不好受，总比眼睛受伤强。

shots.scene: 实验台上的饮料杯和烧杯并排，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a drink cup standing next to a beaker on a lab bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里，不吃不喝。

shots.scene: 两个长得很像的杯子，一个冒出骷髅小图标
shots.prompt_en: Two similar-looking cups side by side, one with a tiny skull icon floating above it. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品会沾进食物，杯子也可能拿错。

shots.scene: 空荡荡的实验室里只有一个人影在操作
shots.prompt_en: A lone figure works in an otherwise empty lab late in the evening.
shots.narration: 尽量别一个人在实验室干活，

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰对着空白日程表商量
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student plan a time together in front of a blank schedule board.
shots.narration: 尤其用机械和危险物质时，和导师商定。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶上贴着菱形四色格标签，数字空白
shots.prompt_en: A reagent bottle with a four-color diamond label, blue, red, yellow and white squares with blank numbers. No people.
shots.narration: 危险品菱形标识，四格各分0到4级。

shots.scene: 四色格分别对应心脏、火焰、爆炸、特殊符号图标
shots.prompt_en: The four-color diamond with icons: a heart in blue, a flame in red, a burst in yellow and a special mark in white. No people.
shots.narration: 蓝是健康，红是易燃，黄是反应性。

shots.scene: 白格旁出现放射性和遇水反应的小图标
shots.prompt_en: Next to the white square, small icons of a radiation trefoil and a water drop with a warning mark appear. No people.
shots.narration: 白格写特殊危害，比如遇水剧烈反应。

shots.scene: 0到4的刻度条，从绿到红
shots.prompt_en: A scale bar with five steps from zero to four, shading from green to red, next to a four-color diamond label. No people.
shots.narration: 0是没什么大碍，4是极其危险。

shots.section_title: 用前先读安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研从文件夹里抽出一份空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pulls a blank safety data sheet from a binder on a shelf.
shots.narration: 想了解化学品，查安全技术说明书。
overlay: 用前先读安全技术说明书

shots.section_title: 用前先读安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 说明书上危害、防护、急救三个图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet with three icons: a warning triangle, a goggles icon and a first aid cross. No people.
shots.narration: 危害、防护、急救方法，都写在里面。

shots.section_title: 用前先读安全技术说明书
shots.scene: 小研先读说明书，再伸手去拿试剂
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads the safety data sheet first, then reaches for the reagent bottle.
shots.narration: 碰化学品之前，就该读过。

shots.scene: 一排液体瓶，只有水瓶没有火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of liquid bottles, each with a small flame icon except one bottle of water. No people.
shots.narration: 除了水，把液体都当易燃的看。

shots.scene: 通风柜里的烟气被吸向上方排走
shots.prompt_en: Inside a fume hood, colored fumes are drawn up and out through the exhaust with arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 通风柜把柜里的空气抽走。

shots.scene: 小研在通风柜里操作，戴护目镜手套
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works inside a fume hood wearing a lab coat, goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 可能产生有害烟气的操作，放在柜里做。

shots.scene: 手指按下通风柜的风机开关
shots.prompt_en: A gloved finger presses the fan switch on a fume hood control panel with a blank display. No people.
shots.narration: 用之前，先打开风机。

shots.scene: 视窗拉到侧面的标线箭头处
shots.prompt_en: A fume hood sash being lowered to an arrow marker on the side frame. No people.
shots.narration: 视窗放到标示的高度。

shots.scene: 视窗高过标线、报警灯亮、烟气外逸，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a sash raised above the marker with an alarm lamp and fumes escaping toward a face, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 拉得太高，排风不够，烟气会扑到脸上。

shots.scene: 阿杰闻到一股气味，皱眉咳嗽
shots.prompt_en: The young male student near a fume hood frowns and coughs after catching a whiff of a smell.
shots.narration: 吸进一点一氧化氮，过会儿好像没事。

shots.scene: 头痛、恶心、头晕几个症状图标，旁边时钟
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a headache, nausea and dizziness next to a clock showing time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 可是有的伤害，会过一阵才显出来。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The young male student tells the older man what happened; the older man listens carefully.
shots.narration: 拿不准轻重，也要马上报告。

shots.scene: 凑近瓶口直接闻的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a nose right over an open bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 想闻气味，别把鼻子凑上去。

shots.scene: 小研用手把瓶口上方的空气扇向鼻子
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a bottle at a distance and gently wafts the air above it toward her nose with her hand.
shots.narration: 用手把气味轻轻扇过来。

shots.scene: 舌头尝试剂的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a tongue near a beaker, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不用尝的办法来检验。

shots.scene: 嘴含移液管吸液的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a mouth sucking on a glass pipette, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不用嘴吸移液管。

shots.scene: 老周皱眉回忆，旁边一支移液管和酸液图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: The older man frowns as he remembers; beside him an icon of a pipette with acid is crossed out with a red X.
shots.narration: 有位化学顾问，两次把酸吸进了嘴里。

shots.scene: 移液管上装着洗耳球
shots.prompt_en: A glass pipette with a rubber pipette bulb attached at its top, held by a gloved hand. No people.
shots.narration: 要用洗耳球之类的辅助器。

shots.scene: 小研用移液器吸液
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws liquid with a handheld pipette into a tube.
shots.narration: 现在更多用的是移液器。

shots.scene: 慢吞吞倒液，液体沿瓶壁流下的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of liquid poured too slowly, dribbling down the outside of a bottle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 倒液体太犹豫，液体会顺着瓶壁流。

shots.scene: 小研在水槽上方稳稳倒液进烧杯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student pours water from a bottle into a beaker over a sink in one steady motion.
shots.narration: 起倒、收尾都干脆，一气呵成。

shots.scene: 割伤的手图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand with a small cut and a bandage beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室最常见的伤，是割伤和刺伤。

shots.scene: 徒手捡碎玻璃的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand picking up broken glass, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 多发生在清理碎玻璃的时候。

shots.scene: 阿杰用小扫帚和簸箕扫碎玻璃
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, wearing gloves and goggles, sweeps broken glass into a dustpan with a small brush.
shots.narration: 用扫帚和簸箕，不用手。

shots.scene: 碎玻璃倒进专用的硬质收集箱
shots.prompt_en: Broken glass is poured from a dustpan into a rigid broken-glass collection box. No people.
shots.narration: 倒进专门的碎玻璃收集箱。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润滑、近握
shots.scene: 玻璃管被硬插进塞子、折断扎手的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a glass tube forced into a rubber stopper snapping and pointing at a palm, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 最怕的是把玻璃管硬往塞子里插。
overlay: 玻璃管插塞子：润滑、近握

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润滑、近握
shots.scene: 塞孔和玻璃管端沾一点水的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of a drop of water applied to the end of a glass tube and the hole of a rubber stopper. No people.
shots.narration: 先用水或润滑剂润湿。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润滑、近握
shots.scene: 老周戴厚手套，手握靠近塞子处慢慢旋入
shots.prompt_en: The older man, wearing thick gloves and goggles, holds the glass tube very close to the stopper and gently twists it in.
shots.narration: 手握在靠近塞子的地方，慢慢旋进去。

shots.section_title: 玻璃管插塞子：润滑、近握
shots.scene: 另一只手挡在玻璃管对面的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand holding the stopper directly in line with the tube's path, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 另一只手，别放在对面。

shots.scene: 废液倒进水槽的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a beaker of waste liquid being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 产物别随手倒水槽，除非安全负责人批准。

shots.scene: 稀释过的酸碱溶液随大量水流进水槽的示意
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram of a diluted acid solution flowing into a lab sink with plenty of running water. No people.
shots.narration: 常见的酸碱，稀释后可以冲掉。

shots.scene: 几只贴空白标签、颜色不同的废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Several waste containers with blank labels in different colors, standing on a spill tray. No people.
shots.narration: 放进对应的废物容器。

shots.scene: 两种废液混在一起冒泡冒烟的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two waste liquids mixing in one container, bubbling and fuming, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 倒错桶，可能和里面的东西反应。

shots.section_title: 用之前，先知道怎么处置
shots.scene: 小研在实验计划上写下废物去向
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes a waste disposal step on a blank experiment plan before starting.
shots.narration: 用一种化学品之前，先想好怎么处置。
overlay: 用之前，先知道怎么处置

shots.scene: 小研在实验服外系上耐酸围裙
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties on a chemical-resistant apron over her lab coat before handling a concentrated acid bottle.
shots.narration: 处理浓酸，可以加一条防护围裙。

shots.scene: 围裙被溅湿后一拉就脱下
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a splashed apron being quickly pulled off over the head. No people.
shots.narration: 溅上了，一解就能脱下。

shots.section_title: 衣物大量沾染，立即脱掉
shots.scene: 裤子大片沾染的图标，旁边一个向下箭头
shots.prompt_en: An icon of trousers with a large chemical stain and a down arrow showing them being taken off. No people.
shots.narration: 衣物大片沾上危险品，别顾面子。
overlay: 衣物大量沾染，立即脱掉

shots.section_title: 衣物大量沾染，立即脱掉
shots.scene: 王老师拉起帘子，旁边放着干净替换衣物
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a privacy curtain beside a shelf with clean spare clothes.
shots.narration: 立刻脱下来。

shots.scene: 紧急喷淋装置和喷淋标志
shots.prompt_en: An emergency safety shower with a green emergency shower sign. No people.
shots.narration: 紧急喷淋，一拉就是大量的水。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在喷淋下，边冲边脱去沾染的外衣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands under the safety shower pulling the handle, removing his contaminated lab coat as water pours down.
shots.narration: 边冲洗，边脱去沾染的衣物。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现七张空白卡片，依次翻开
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside seven blank cards that flip over one by one.
shots.narration: 最后，回顾一下这七件事。

shots.scene: 扎起的头发、护目镜、包脚鞋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of tied-up hair, goggles and closed-toe shoes, each with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 扎头发、戴护目、穿包脚鞋。

shots.scene: 安全标签、说明书、通风柜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hazard label with pictograms, a blank safety data sheet and a fume hood. No people.
shots.narration: 看懂标签，先读说明书，用好通风柜。

shots.scene: 扇闻手势、洗耳球、碎玻璃箱图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a wafting hand, a pipette bulb and a broken-glass collection box. No people.
shots.narration: 扇闻、不口吸，碎玻璃不用手捡。

shots.scene: 废液桶和喷淋头图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of labeled waste containers and an emergency shower head. No people.
shots.narration: 废物分开放，沾染了马上冲。

shots.scene: 电话图标和报告单
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon and a blank report form. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事，拿不准也要报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着护目镜，在整洁的实验室里挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears safety goggles and waves goodbye in a tidy lab.
shots.narration: 护好自己，安心做实验，下次见！
